entities.summary: Kurikka is a town and municipality in Finland. It is located in the South Ostrobothnia region. The population of Kurikka is 19,457 and the municipality covers an area of 1,724.62 km2 (665.88 sq mi) of which 7.79 km2 (3.01 sq mi) is inland water. The population density is 11.28/km2 (29.2/sq mi). The municipality is unilingually Finnish. Kurikka is a town in Northern Europe, established around 1868. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
